use default

flip(cell: char) -> char => if cell == '#' then '.' else '#' fi

step(cells: string, rule: int) -> string is
    let left = flip(cells[0])
    let right = flip(cells[cells.length - 1])
    let padded = "{left}{left}{cells}{right}{right}"
    let next = LIST()

    for i in 1..padded.length - 1 do
        let pattern = (0..3)
            |> map(offset => padded[i - 1 + offset])
            |> map(cell => if cell == '#' then 1 else 0 fi)
            |> reduce(0, (bits, bit) => bits * 2 + bit)

        next.add(if (rule >> pattern) & 1 == 1 then '#' else '.' fi)
    od

    return string(next.to_array())

    let cells mut = start

    while true do
        yield cells
        cells = step(cells, rule)
